function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT sku, period, AVG(unit_cost_cad) AS avg_unit_cost, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line WHERE currency = 'CAD' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY sku, period ORDER BY sku, period","purpose":"First query: compare unit_cost_cad by sku across periods for CAD vendors"}
